title: Who will win the 2026 Formula One Dutch Grand Prix?
resolution_criteria:
Source of Truth : The FIA's official race classification or Formula One's official race results for the 2026 Dutch Grand Prix. 
  Resolution Conditions : Resolve to the driver officially classified as the winner of the Grand Prix's main race, rather than a qualifying session or sprint race. 
  Accepted Answer Format : The winning driver's full name.
